correctness.rationale: The antiunitary selfadjoint antilinear part T=(A+A^{-1})/2 has quadratic numerical radius ||T||=||I+A²||/2, with top eigenspace determined by the peripheral spectral projection; q-pair Cauchy–Schwarz optimization yields the two-branch disk radius. Circularity, connected two-frame space, existence of an isotropic vector and orthogonal complement dimension>=2 yield the full disk including the origin. Top spectral eigenvectors give outer attainment and direct sums yield nonattainment. This is the same mathematically valid radius and status theorem as the earlier Nov 1 publication; correctness is distinct from originality.
